scope: Derive timestep, linear/angular velocity caps and gravity from native uniforms on device
tolerance_reason: Only computed velocity caps use f32 tolerance. Timestep, gravity, sentinel, zero timestep and guards are exact.
preconditions: Native Rust-derived RbdSimParams layout, finite nonnegative timestep/cap and positive length unit
Finite gravity; num_solver_iterations is a native u32 including zero
invariants: Zero timestep yields zero angular cap
Zero solver iterations uses the same max(1) divisor as Rust
Only Nexus MAX_FLT disables length-unit scaling, not neighboring floats
Readonly uniforms and trailing words remain unchanged
